race.comment: I'M KENNY (3) was in contention on the bend and ran a better race last start to finish a close second over 1498m at this track. Finds a suitable race and can build on that solid recent effort. EXONUMIA (1) got the prize two runs ago at Roxby Downs. Safely held last time out when fourth over 1400m at Quorn. Stepping up a level this time but on his best form he is capable of a big performance. TI TREE ROYAL (5) bounced back to somewhere near his best last time at Murray Bridge when closing off well into sixth, only beaten 2.5L a week-and-a-half ago. Yet to miss the frame in two starts over this course and distance. Perfectly placed and is sure to be there at the finish. AUGUSTA ROCK (4) progressed nicely last time out to finish just 1.4 lengths from the winner in second over 1400m at Quorn. Has his share of ability and is a top-three prospect. URBANISE (8) wasn't far away last time out and a similar effort here can see the old boy find a spot in the frame.
